hypothesis: A last reliable observed-ball H/A control estimate with decaying age bias improves dense ensemble spell recovery through missing-ball gaps without harming clean or feed-like full-provider holdouts.

method.anchor: Observed-ball frame with max(P(H), P(A)) >= 0.80 and absolute H/A margin >= 0.20; retain that team and timestamp.
method.gap_adjustment: Only during missing-ball frames, add a same-team H/A log-odds bias capped at 0.25 and decaying with a 5-second half-life. Preserve D/X and H+A mass.
method.reset: Clear anchor at period changes, non-increasing timestamps, or an observed-ball frame that does not meet reliability thresholds.

comparison: Exact matched current dense controls, both seeds and their equal-probability ensemble, same full-provider holdout cells under clean and feed-like views. Replay existing control metrics and predictions before candidate scoring.
scoring_status: not started; awaiting exact full-provider holdout control arrays and replay
